verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own receipt upload with automatic matching to existing expenses ("Upload receipt and match automatically"), and its marketing says AI assistants fetch receipts for employees, so the core of filing a receipt against the right transaction is evidenced. The employee-facing capture channels are not: the mobile app evidence covers only card management and spend viewing, nothing describes forwarding receipts by email, and OCR of receipt contents is never stated. missing for 10: documented mobile photo capture of receipts, email-forwarding intake, explicit OCR/data extraction from receipts, independent or hands-on corroboration of match accuracy
